blocks.title: Binary search
blocks.text: Binary search tarteeb wali list mein talash ka daira baar baar aadha kar ke aur woh aadha chhor kar jahan cheez nahi ho sakti, cheez dhoondti hai, jab tak cheez na mile ya daira khali na ho.

items: Tarteeb wali list ki darmiyani cheez se shuru karein.
Agar wahi matlooba hai to us ki jagah lautayein.
Matlooba chhota ho to baen aadhe par dohrayein.
Matlooba bara ho to daen aadhe par dohrayein.

blocks.text: [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13] mein 7 ki talash darmiyani cheez, 7, se shuru ho kar foran mil jati hai. Binary search O(log n) hai, bare datasets ke liye linear search se kahin tez. Yeh sirf tarteeb wali lists par chalti hai: be-tarteeb data ko pehle tarteeb dein, maslan merge sort se (Tip).

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: merge sort [14, 7, 3, 12] ko aadhon aur akeli qeematon mein baant kar [7, 14], [3, 12] aur [3, 7, 12, 14] mein jorta hua. Oopar daen: tarteeb wali list 21 34 43 57 66 78 ki teen qataarein jo 78 ki binary search darmiyani qeematon 43, 66 aur 78 ke saath dikhati hain. Neeche baen: jarr 0, bachche 1, 2, 3 aur pote 4, 5, 6, 7 wala darakht BFS aur DFS tarteeb ke saath. Neeche daen: greedy, dynamic programming, backtracking, sorting aur searching ke notes.
blocks.caption: Merge sort, binary search, BFS aur DFS (topics 3.5 se 3.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Merge sort [14, 7, 3, 12] ko [14, 7] aur [3, 12] mein, phir akele adad mein baantta, aur wapas [7, 14] aur [3, 12] aur aakhir mein [3, 7, 12, 14] jorta hai. 21, 34, 43, 57, 66, 78 mein 78 ki binary search darmiyani qeemat 43 dekhti hai jo chhoti hai, to daen aadha rakhti hai; agli darmiyani qeemat 66 bhi chhoti hai, to phir daen aadha rakh kar teen qadmon mein index 5 par 78 pa leti hai. Jis darakht ki jarr 0, bachche 1, 2 aur 3, aur pote 1 ke neeche 4 aur 5, 2 ke neeche 6 aur 3 ke neeche 7 hon, us par BFS level ba level 0 se 7 tak tarteeb se jata, jabke DFS pehle gehrai mein jata hai: 0, 1, 4, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7.

blocks.prompt: Search masail ki khasusiyat aur linear aur binary search ka muwazna bataiye (long question 3).
blocks.explanation: Search masla majmooa aur matlooba cheez deta aur poochta hai ke woh hai ya nahi, aur kahan; jawab jagah ya 'nahi mili' hota hai. Linear search cheezein ek ek kar ke dekhti, har list par chalti aur bad-tareen soorat mein O(n) leti hai; binary search ko tarteeb wali list chahiye, har qadam par daira aadha karti aur O(log n) leti hai. 10 lakh tarteeb wali cheezon ke liye linear search ko 10 lakh jaanchein lag sakti hain, binary search ko taqreeban 20. Chhoti ya be-tarteeb lists ke liye linear search saada hai; bari tarteeb wali lists ke liye binary search kahin behtar.

items: Binary search: har qadam par tarteeb wala daira aadha; 21..78 mein 78 teen qadmon mein; O(log n).
